queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Azure Data Studio' AND publisher = 'Microsoft Corporation';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Azure Data Studio' AND publisher = 'Microsoft Corporation' AND version_compare(version, '1.52.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'azure data studio.exe');
